pixelboard.description: PixelBoard is a sleek, ultra-clean enhancement of Google's flagship keyboard. Tailored for pure productivity, PixelBoard strips away unnecessary bloatware and focuses strictly on powerhouse capabilities: Gemini Rambler Natural Voice Dictation, AI Writing Assistant, Modern Spell Checker Suggestion Chips & Grammar Checking, Scan Text Camera OCR, Screenshot Floating Suggestions, Material 3 Expressive Rounded Keys, Emoji Palette V2, Super Insert Quick Hub, Restored Emoji Size Slider & Vibrant Emojis, Samsung & Vivo Clipboard History Sync, and Automatic Zero-Restart Instant Activation.
